name: Hemi
description: Fitted to the 596 hand-placed point pairs of defish-hemi-596.json (0.9 px RMS). A fisheye lens seen through a Panini-style cylindrical projection: vertical lines straight, horizontal lines gently curved.

lens.note: angle from the optical axis (radians) = sum theta[i] r^(2i+1), r = distance from the photo's centre in photo widths

projection.note: x = scale * (panini+1) sin(lon)/(panini+cos(lon)) * (1 + sum horizontal[i] sin^(2i+2) lon); y = scale * (paniniVertical+1)/(paniniVertical+cos(lon)) * tan(lat) * (1 + sum vertical[i][j] sin^(2i+2) lat sin^(2j) lon), in frame widths
